boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, under-21-safe ways to spend time together in Castine without an admission charge or required purchase.

cards.title: Join a Castine Uncovered walk
cards.subtitle: Starts at Abbott School, 17 School Street
cards.notes: Meet friends at the Abbott School for the scheduled hour-long route; wear walking shoes for the half-mile tour and its inclines.
cards.short_summary: A free, guide-led introduction to Castine’s historic streets and landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Castine Historical Society lists its 2026 walking tours as free of charge, with no reservation required.
cards.access_notes: Friday, Saturday, and Monday at 10 AM, June 20–October 12; meet in front of Abbott School.

cards.title: Follow the free walking map
cards.subtitle: Available outside Abbott School, 17 School Street
cards.notes: Pick up the map from the outdoor brochure rack, choose a partner or small group, and work through the self-guided historic route.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, self-paced town walk using the Historical Society’s printed guide.
cards.evidence_claim: The Castine Historical Society states that its walking map and detailed self-guided tour are free.
cards.access_notes: Maps and brochures are in the rack outside the Abbott School; take only during public access to the exterior rack.

cards.title: Take the Castine Virtual Tour
cards.subtitle: Self-guided around Castine
cards.notes: Download the virtual tour before heading out, then use it to structure a shared walk among the town’s historic sites.
cards.short_summary: A free phone-based route for exploring Castine at your own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: The Castine Historical Society says the Castine Virtual Tour can be downloaded for free onto a phone.
cards.access_notes: Self-guided; use a charged phone and follow normal pedestrian safety practices.

cards.entity_name: Francis Hamabe’s Maine: A Life in Art
cards.title: See Francis Hamabe’s Maine
cards.subtitle: Abbott School Museum, 17 School Street
cards.notes: Visit with classmates during museum hours and spend time with the art, archival material, and photographs in this seasonal exhibition.
cards.short_summary: A current Castine Historical Society art exhibition with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historical Society identifies Francis Hamabe’s Maine as its 2026 exhibition and says it has multiple free exhibits for visitors.
cards.access_notes: The Historical Society lists the Abbott School Museum as open Monday–Saturday 10–4 and Sunday 1–4 during its 2026 season.

cards.title: Browse the Penobscot Expedition exhibit
cards.subtitle: Abbott School Museum, 17 School Street
cards.notes: Use the exhibition as a conversation starter with friends, then compare its Revolutionary-era story with sites visible on the town walk.
cards.short_summary: A named Historical Society exhibition available without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historical Society lists Penobscot Expedition 1779: Making Revolutionary History among its exhibits and describes its visitor exhibits as free.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Abbott School Museum seasonal hours; confirm any holiday changes before traveling.

cards.title: Look closely at the Bicentennial Quilt
cards.subtitle: Abbott School Museum, 17 School Street
cards.notes: Meet up at the Abbott School and take time to examine the quilt’s details together as part of the Historical Society’s exhibit display.
cards.short_summary: A named Castine Historical Society textile exhibit with free visitor access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historical Society lists the Castine Community Bicentennial Quilt as an exhibit and says visitors can see multiple free exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Visit during Abbott School Museum seasonal hours; the exhibit setting is indoors.

cards.title: See the Noah Brooks display
cards.subtitle: Witherle Memorial Library, 41 School Street
cards.notes: Stop by with a friend to view the Brooks memorabilia display, including items loaned from the Castine Historical Society, during July and August.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal library display tied to a free public lecture series.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historical Society says the Witherle Library’s Noah Brooks memorabilia displays remain during July and August and that the associated lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Noah Brooks Series Night 3 with Ted Lameyer at the Witherle Library
cards.access_notes: The cited display is seasonal for July and August; check with Witherle Memorial Library before a special trip.

cards.entity_name: CHS Bean Supper and Volunteer Appreciation
cards.title: Attend the CHS Bean Supper
cards.subtitle: Castine Historical Society event, August 29, 2026
cards.notes: Plan a group visit to this community supper and volunteer appreciation event; review the organizer’s page for final location details before going.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, free community meal and gathering hosted by the Historical Society.
cards.evidence_claim: The Castine Historical Society describes its August 29, 2026 Bean Supper and Volunteer Appreciation as a free event, with donations accepted but not required.
cards.source_title: CHS Bean Supper and Volunteer Appreciation
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for August 29, 2026, 5–7 PM; organizer says event details are forthcoming, so confirm location before attending.

cards.entity_name: Buoy House Math and Physics Help Sessions
cards.title: Bring a classmate to help sessions
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Success, Buoy House, 54 Pleasant Street
cards.notes: Coordinate with a classmate, check the tutoring schedule, and use the Academy’s math or physics help session to work through a tough problem.
cards.short_summary: Free academic-support sessions for enrolled MMA students.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy says regularly scheduled math and physics help sessions are free and available to all enrolled students.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students; consult the Academy’s tutoring schedule or contact the Buoy House for current session times.

cards.entity_name: Maine Maritime Academy Peer Tutoring Program
cards.title: Set up a peer-tutoring study hang
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Success, Buoy House, 54 Pleasant Street
cards.notes: Ask the Buoy House about a peer tutor for your course, then turn the session into a focused, no-cost study meet-up with a classmate.
cards.short_summary: Free course support available to enrolled MMA students through peer tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: Maine Maritime Academy states that its peer tutoring program is free and available to all enrolled students.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students; availability varies by subject, so contact the Buoy House or review the tutoring schedule first.
